title: Twenty Questions, One Lucky Answer
summary: Test twenty outcomes on pure noise at the five per cent level and something comes up significant about two thirds of the time; step through them and see what each correction costs.

sources.title: Benjamini and Hochberg, Controlling the False Discovery Rate, JRSS B 1995
Simes, An improved Bonferroni procedure for multiple tests of significance, Biometrika 1986
